 Cavs Need Donovan Mitchell To Step Up
--> Cavs Need Donovan Mitchell To Step Up
 While he has not exactly been “bad”, Donovan Mitchell is off to the worst statistical start of his Cleveland tenure. 21.9 points per game is his lowest, and comes after he averaged 28 a contest a season ago. The turnovers, at 3.1 a night, are the most he has posted per night since his final season with the Jazz.

Even in a game where he dropped 11 assists the other night, it still felt like Mitchell wasn’t picking his spots correctly. He has struggled to shoot the rock, going 6-17 from the floor (as seen below).

He has been living on the perimeter, and while it’s nice to see him pull off some fancy moves out there, his signature step-through has to be tried more. He can’t be firing jump shots all night.

 41.2% of Mitchell’s shots have been from 3PT, which isn’t too far off from a year ago, but considering that he’s taking five fewer per night, it’s not ideal. They need him to be aggressive and to be the top option as a scorer in this game. He has to go toe-to-toe with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. His demeanor and aggression help to unlock everything else for the rest of the team.
